allow: PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(15\); do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } until \($c -or \(Get-Date\) -gt $deadline\); if \($c\) { "LISTENING \(PID $\($c.OwningProcess\)\)" } else { "NOT LISTENING" })

PowerShell($pid9222 = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9222 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1\).OwningProcess; if \($pid9222\) { Get-Process -Id $pid9222 | Select-Object ProcessName, Id, Path } else { 'No process on port 9222' })

PowerShell($conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9222 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($conn\) { $conn | Format-Table LocalAddress, LocalPort, State, OwningProcess; foreach \($c in $conn\) { try { $p = Get-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output \("PID {0} = {1} \({2}\)" -f $p.Id, $p.ProcessName, $p.Path\) } catch { Write-Output \("PID {0}: {1}" -f $c.OwningProcess, $_.Exception.Message\) } } } else { Write-Output 'No TCP connections on 9222' })
